description: This file contains the implementation of jQuery's event handling system, including event registration, removal, triggering, and normalization of event objects. It defines the jQuery.event object with methods for managing events, as well as extending jQuery with event-related functions like on, off, trigger, and triggerHandler.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds event handlers to elements, supporting multiple event types and namespaces.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes event handlers from elements based on specified criteria.

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Triggers an event on selected elements, optionally with data.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event to the appropriate handlers, managing event propagation.

methods.name: handlers
methods.description: Determines the list of handlers to execute for an event, including delegated handlers.

methods.name: fix
methods.description: Normalizes native event objects into jQuery.Event objects with consistent properties.

methods.name: simulate
methods.description: Simulates an event of a given type on an element.
